## Experience & Research
- **IFRO / GPMecatrônica Research Group** (Jan 2025 – Dec 2025): Administrative Assistant & Software Developer. Web development with Next.js and oRPC, Docker and Nix environments, and robotics studies.
- **Censipam / Ministry of Defense** (Aug 2023 – Oct 2024): IT Infrastructure Intern. Computer assembly, hardware diagnostics, Linux/Windows OS deployment, and network/VoIP cabling.
- **IFRO / GoTec Research Group** (Feb 2024 – Jul 2024): Scientific Researcher (Fellow). Developed the "Innovation Radar" web platform with React, Laravel, and MySQL.
- **IFRO / GoTec Research Group** (Sep 2023 – Feb 2024): Voluntary Researcher. Web architecture and database modeling. Outreach at Expo Favela and SNCT.

## Featured Projects
- **toof-os** (https://github.com/o-thiago/ToofOS): Declarative NixOS configuration built for the DACC Station (a gaming arcade console project at UNIR) on Raspberry Pi 4 with custom `nix-ld` game runtimes.
- **gpm-cards** (https://github.com/o-thiago/gpm-cards): Web platform for member profiles and card generation for GPMecatrônica with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Nix process-compose services.
- **sqlx-conditional-queries-layering** (https://github.com/o-thiago/sqlx-conditional-queries-layering): Declarative macro library in Rust for composing and merging conditional SQL query templates on top of SQLx. Author: @o-thiago.
- **Innovation Radar**: Web platform for tracking innovation initiatives and research IP at IFRO with React, Laravel, Docker.
